text:
Maria (People Ops): Heads up — a couple of new recruiters reported the 'Interviewer quicklinks' dropdown missing on profiles for orgs created over the weekend. Anyone else?
Sam (Recruiting Ops): I can reproduce with a fresh test org. The rest of the profile loads but quicklinks is blank.
Lee (Recruiter): Hit this with a new hire yesterday. We told them to copy the calendar link manually. Not ideal.
Jen (Talent): Could be a permissions/flag issue tied to the migration that created many orgs.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Quick audit: feature_flags table in staging shows the 'interviewer_quicklinks' row wasn't created for orgs provisioned after the migration cutoff.
Maria (People Ops): Oof. Non-destructive fix options?
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Two paths: flip feature via admin console for affected orgs, or run a scoped DB backfill to insert/enable the flag rows. Prefer console if small count.
Ashley (SRE): We can run a backfill during low traffic. Example SQL (will batch):
```
UPDATE feature_flags
SET enabled = true
WHERE name = 'interviewer_quicklinks'
  AND org_id IN (/*ids*/)
  AND created_at >= '2026-03-20';
```
Coordinate with us before running.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): I'll try admin console first. If any 4xx, will pass to SRE.
Lee (Recruiter): Also request a temporary in-app banner to avoid confusion: "If Quicklinks missing, use the Interviewer calendar link on the profile." Jen can draft.
Jen (Talent): Drafted copy and will ping #product-ux for a quick 1-hr banner deploy.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Admin console fixed 19/22 orgs. Three still return 401 on the toggle. Likely created during the DB window. Asking SRE to run backfill for those.
Ashley (SRE): DM me the three org ids. I'll run the backfill tonight in small batches and monitor.
nats-bot: audit.log:feature_flag.updated — user=Sam (Recruiting Ops) — flag=interviewer_quicklinks — scope=19 orgs
Lee (Recruiter): Confirmed for Zoe's org — dropdown is back.
Ashley (SRE): Backfill completed for remaining 3 orgs, no errors, verified flag=true.
Maria (People Ops): Thanks — I'll notify the affected new hires that the UI is fixed and CC recruiting ops.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Filing a short postmortem and adding a checklist item to onboarding: verify critical feature flags post-org-provision. Moving thread to resolved.
Jen (Talent): Checklist item added. Closing. :tada:
